items.text: Product, pricing, store service and gold risk, and five things to settle together

notes: Four things today. The first three are changes outside our walls: where the gold price stands, how customers buy gold now, and who in the trade is closing stores along with the new tax and standards. The fourth is us: how we shape next year's range, how we price, how we run store services and how we manage gold-price risk. The last few items are not decisions head office has already made. We want to make them with you.
